风险驾驶舱: リスクダッシュボード
请输入问题。: 質問を入力してください。
先看风险，再处理账目。预测只使用你已确认的数据。: Review risks before changing entries. Forecasts use only data you have confirmed.
只处理风控数据，不影响计时记录和便签。导出文件是明文 JSON，分享后不再受本机: Only risk control data is affected; timer sessions and notes are unchanged. The exported JSON is unencrypted and is no longer protected by this app after sharing. Merge restore adds entries found only in the backup and keeps the current version for matching IDs.
可以在这里查看最近记录、恢复归档任务，或清理不再需要的旧记录。: View recent sessions, restore archived tasks, or remove old sessions you no longer need.
如果手机上出了问题，先点记录日志，再把生成的文件发回来。导出数据会打包当前九宫格: If you encounter a problem on your phone, start recording a log and share the generated file. The export includes the current timer grid, backup status, and recent app events.
已完成的记录按时间排序，方便你回看当天的节奏，也能删除不再需要的条目。: Completed sessions are sorted by time so you can review the day and remove entries you no longer need.
把账本压成几个可以行动的信号：留存、缓冲、杠杆、资产和记录质量。: The ledger highlights actionable signals: savings, cash buffer, debt, assets, and record quality.
暂时无法生成风险结论。先保存一笔收支后再试。: A risk assessment is not available yet. Save an income or expense entry and try again.
本周期还没有可计算的收入和分类支出。: This period has no recorded income or categorized expenses to calculate.
资产快照不能替代现金流。至少核对一天收支后再评分；当前只展示已确认的资产负债事实: An asset snapshot cannot replace cash-flow records. Confirm at least one day of income and expenses before scoring. Only confirmed assets and liabilities are shown now.
预测采用当前收支节奏；压力情景按收入 -20%、支出 +15%。: The forecast uses your current income and spending pace. The stress scenario assumes income falls 20% and expenses rise 15%.
删除后会同步到其他设备。: Deletion will sync to your other devices.
收入为 0，仅显示各类支出占比，暂不判断收入约束。: Income is zero. Expense shares are shown, but limits relative to income are not assessed.
这里改的是风控分类口径。标签和目标比例一改，明细、结构卡片和提醒都会一起变化。: Changes here affect risk control categories. Editing a label or target ratio also updates the details, breakdown cards, and alerts.
还没有可读取的通话记录，或者系统没有授予访问权限。: There is no readable call history, or the system has not granted access.
这张图片暂时不可用，可能已经被删除。: This image is unavailable and may have been deleted.
回收站里的便签和图片会一起清空，无法恢复。: Notes and images in the trash will be permanently deleted and cannot be restored.
图片保存在本地，可预览、分享和保存到相册。: 画像はローカルに保存されます。プレビュー、共有、またはギャラリーに保存できます。
恢复后的笔记会回到原来的文件夹，彻底删除会连图片附件一起清走。: Restored documents return to their original folder. Permanent deletion also removes attached images.
取消后，内容会恢复为普通明文便签。: Removing encryption turns this into a regular unencrypted note.
当前便签还没有恢复记录。: This note has no restore history yet.
标题、正文、富文本和版本记录会以密文保存。密码不会保存，也无法找回。: Titles, body text, rich text, and version history are stored encrypted. The password is not stored and cannot be recovered.
复现问题后，回到这里停止收集并导出日志: After reproducing the issue, return here to stop collection and export the log
本次收集已达容量上限，已保留的记录可以导出: This recording reached its size limit. You can export the saved log.
恢复写入失败，当前数据未替换。: Restore could not be saved. Current data was not replaced.
同步不可用，请确认网络和服务地址: Sync unavailable. Check the network and service address.
上传不可用，请确认网络和服务地址: Upload unavailable. Check the network and service address.
拉取不可用，请确认网络和服务地址: Download unavailable. Check the network and service address.
密码至少 6 位: Password must have at least 6 characters.
操作已取消: 操作はキャンセルされました。
未能通过电脑公网入口与账号校验。请确认电脑端同步服务正在运行且电脑可以访问互联网: Could not verify the account through the computer’s public sync address. Make sure its sync service is running and the computer has internet access. If you just signed in, sign out and sign in again. The phone does not need to be on the same local network.
